tasks.description: Update the FAQ section 'What should I know about RoleAssignment naming in ASO?' to document the new `operatorSpec.namingConvention` setting (`stable` default vs `random`) available on RoleAssignment (2020-08-01-preview, 2022-04-01) and RoleDefinition (2022-04-01) when no AzureName is set, noting it is operator-only and not sent to Azure, and that `random` generates a new UUID each time (so it won't be stable across recreation/migration).

Update ADR-2024-04 RoleAssignments UUID Generation to reflect the implemented property name `operatorSpec.namingConvention` (values `stable`/`random`) instead of the placeholder `generationType`, and update the Status/Consequences sections now that the feature is implemented.

branches.question: Where in the docs are RoleAssignment/RoleDefinition operatorSpec or naming conventions documented, and is there a page describing autogenerated AzureName UUID behavior?
How is the namingConvention operatorSpec property implemented and defaulted in the changed code (stable vs random)?
Is there a user-facing docs page (not design ADR) describing RoleAssignment AzureName autogeneration or operatorSpec usage that should mention namingConvention?
Does the ADR-2024-04 document still describe the property as generationType rather than the implemented namingConvention, and does its Status/Consequences need updating now that it is implemented?
